points.title: 早期艺术训练
points.description: 米开朗基罗在佛罗伦萨开始了他的艺术生涯，师从洛伦佐·迪·克雷迪。他在这里学习了绘画、雕塑和建筑，并开始创作自己的作品。他的早期作品《圣约翰的预言》显示了他对古典艺术的深刻理解。
points.descriptionEn: Michelangelo began his artistic career in Florence, studying under Lorenzo di Credi. Here, he learned painting, sculpture, and architecture, and began to create his own works. His early work 'The Prophecy of St. John' shows his deep understanding of classical art.

points.title: 罗马的雕塑工作
points.description: 米开朗基罗在罗马为教皇尤利乌斯二世工作，负责雕塑《圣彼得大教堂的圣彼得雕像》。他的作品展示了他的创新和对古典艺术的尊重。此外，他还参与了圣彼得大教堂的设计。
points.descriptionEn: Michelangelo worked in Rome for Pope Julius II, responsible for the sculpture of St. Peter's Basilica. His work showcased his innovation and respect for classical art. He also participated in the design of St. Peter's Basilica.

points.title: 创作《大卫像》
points.description: 米开朗基罗回到佛罗伦萨，创作了著名的《大卫像》。这座雕塑展示了他的精湛技艺和对古典英雄主义的崇拜。此作品对后世艺术家产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Michelangelo returned to Florence to create the famous 'David'. This sculpture showcased his exquisite skill and admiration for classical heroism. The work had a profound impact on artists of later generations.

points.title: 梵蒂冈的壁画
points.description: 米开朗基罗在梵蒂冈为教皇利奥十世创作了著名的《创世纪》和《最后的审判》壁画。这些作品不仅展示了他的绘画技巧，也反映了他的宗教信仰和对人类命运的深刻思考。
points.descriptionEn: Michelangelo painted the famous 'The Creation of Adam' and 'The Last Judgment' on the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel for Pope Leo X. These works not only showcased his painting skills but also reflected his religious faith and profound thoughts on the human condition.

points.title: 晚年创作与建筑
points.description: 米开朗基罗晚年在罗马继续他的艺术创作，包括雕塑《圣母怜子》和《圣约翰的预言》。他还参与了圣彼得大教堂的重建工作，直到他去世。他的晚年作品继续展示了他对艺术的深刻理解和创新。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years in Rome, Michelangelo continued his artistic creations, including the sculptures 'Pieta' and 'The Prophets'. He also participated in the reconstruction of St. Peter's Basilica until his death. His late works continued to showcase his deep understanding and innovation in art.

appraisal.zh: 米开朗基罗被公认为文艺复兴时期最伟大的艺术家之一，他的雕塑、绘画与建筑作品以无与伦比的技艺和创造力成为人类文化的瑰宝，在历史学界他被视为文艺复兴艺术的代表人物，其作品既反映时代的社会文化背景，也体现个人天才，在大众文化中更被符号化为文艺复兴精神的象征。不过也有研究者指出，他的作品有时过于强调形式与技巧而忽视内容的深度和情感表达，某些宗教作品也被认为过于血腥残酷。
appraisal.en: Michelangelo is widely recognized as one of the greatest artists of the Renaissance, his sculptures, paintings, and architecture standing as treasures of human culture through unparalleled skill and creativity; historians regard him as a representative figure of Renaissance art, whose works reflect both the social and cultural context of his time and individual genius, while popular culture has made him a symbol of the Renaissance spirit. Yet some researchers note that his works sometimes emphasize form and technique at the expense of depth of content and emotional expression, and that certain religious works are considered excessively bloody and cruel.

supporter.zh: 米开朗基罗被誉为文艺复兴时期最伟大的艺术家之一，他的作品对后世产生了深远的影响。他的雕塑、绘画和建筑作品都展示了无与伦比的技艺和创造力，被认为是人类文化的瑰宝。
supporter.en: Michelangelo is hailed as one of the greatest artists of the Renaissance, and his works have had a profound impact on later generations. His sculptures, paintings, and architectural works all showcase unparalleled skill and creativity, considered treasures of human culture.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为，米开朗基罗的作品过于强调形式和技巧，忽视了内容的深度和情感的表达。此外，他的某些宗教作品被认为过于血腥和残酷。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Michelangelo's works emphasize form and technique too much, neglecting the depth of content and the expression of emotion. Moreover, some of his religious works are considered too bloody and cruel.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，米开朗基罗被视为文艺复兴艺术的代表人物，他的作品不仅反映了当时的社会和文化背景，也体现了个人天才的创造力。在大众文化中，他常常被符号化为文艺复兴精神的象征。
objective.en: In the historical field, Michelangelo is regarded as a representative figure of Renaissance art, whose works reflect both the social and cultural context of the time and the creative genius of the individual. In popular culture, he is often symbolized as the embodiment of the Renaissance spirit.

self.zh: 艺术家的生命在于艺术之中。
self.en: The life of an artist is in art.
